statement: The generic exceptional curves in the repaired degree-one Kato family have no proper analytic divisor closure or extending relative proper contraction; any smooth r-semistable cap retaining such an ordinary exceptional curve off the conductor and the holomorphic base map forces rational curves in nearby ordinary surface fibres.
depends_on: B.4.10; B.4.20; B.4.21; exact marked elliptic intersection; normal sequence; Dloussky-Teleman Proposition2.3
R_items_and_Leads_used: Actual Kato marking independently checked; no Lead assumed
notes: Root and limits_ab independently passed. Winding is (12,0), multiplied by every finite base change. Normal bundle is O(-1) plus O squared and the two base derivatives induce an H0 isomorphism. Curves meeting the conductor, a changed central component or a changed holomorphic base map remain outside the conclusion. No unrestricted origin-cap nonexistence claim.
